# Njure Group

> A diversified enterprise ecosystem headquartered in Kerala, India, driving innovation across enterprise technology, handloom heritage preservation, hyperlocal trade marketplaces, and clean mobility engineering.

Official Domain: https://njuregroup.in
Headquarters: Vattoli Bazar, Balussery, Kozhikode, Kerala 673612, India
Primary Contact Email: info@njuregroup.in
Executive Talent & Careers: info@njuregroup.in (CC: neerej.suresan.s@gmail.com)
Corporate Hotline / Telephone: +91 8281877050

## Core Operating Divisions

- [Njure Tech](https://tech.njuregroup.in): Enterprise Technology, IT Service Management (ITSM) automation via ScribbleIT, low-latency conversational voice AI, and zero-trust cloud infrastructure.
- [Vastrathalam](https://vastrathalam.njuregroup.in): Handloom heritage apparel preserving authentic Kerala Kasavu weaves (Balaramapuram, Chendamangalam, Kuthampully) with 100% fair trade direct weaver compensation.
- [Dozo](https://dozo.njuregroup.in): Hyperlocal neighborhood service and artisan trade marketplace empowering local electricians, plumbers, and technicians with >92% earnings retention and instant digital escrow.
- [B+ Energies](https://njuregroup.in/#/verticals): Sustainable clean mobility engineering developing parallel hybrid motorcycle powertrains that reduce daily household commuting fuel costs by 45–60%.

## Cultural Identity

Njure Group proudly integrates the cultural ethos and artistry of Kerala ("God's Own Country"), celebrating the Kathakali dance heritage, Nilavilakku brass lamps, Chundan Vallam snake boats, Nettipattam elephant caparisons, Chenda percussion, and lush coconut palm landscapes.
